title: enform draft.edited@1 event payload
description: The payload of a draft.edited@1 event (#256, ADR 0014, RT-3, FM-7, I1, D1). The starter changed the values a draft holds: one operation per edit, with the id the client chose, so a retry appends nothing (I1). The values merge over what the draft holds; the submit validates them (FM-4).

instanceId.description: The id of the draft the edit acts on (DX-1).

values.description: The field keys the edit changed, each with its new JSON value (FM-7).

jsonValue.description: One JSON value: a string, number, boolean, null, array or object (FM-7, DF-1).
